mission: Build a fractal Google Maps of law for Swiss Federal Supreme Court case law from 2000 onward plus user-imported corpora, beating simple semantic-map baselines in legal usefulness.

corpus.question: Scale the canonical TF-2000+ acquisition/normalization pipeline from current 1,577 decisions (1000 slice + 250 yearly core 2020-2024) to full coverage (2000-2024, ~192k decisions) via OpenCaseLaw bulk ingestion. Build citation ID resolution pipeline (BGE/ATF → corpus decision_id) to unlock citation role modeling integration. Implement robust user corpus import with schema validation and map artifact persistence.

legal-distance.question: (1) REPRODUCE center_projected representation on current codebase and validate on full v1+v2 benchmark suite; (2) Re-run signal ablation (v4) and scale test (v5) USING center_projected as baseline (superseding debiased_citation_blended results); (3) Legal embeddings: test multilingual-e5-small fine-tuning on Swiss legal corpus for multilingual invariance WITH coarse legal structure; (4) Citation role modeling: integrate 2,988 role annotations once citation ID resolution pipeline ready; (5) Execute jurist pairwise evaluation of hybrid map modes vs center_projected baseline (framework ready, needs 5-10 Swiss jurists); (6) Benchmark refinement: maintain refined 16-benchmark suite with adversarial gates as primary.

fractal-map.question: ALL 12 breakthrough representations VALIDATED (v8 REPRODUCED, v9 CONFIRMED) with two distinct design patterns: (a) HIGH-PURITY (Metric Learning): linear_metric_epoch4 (Fine=0.9754, NMI=0.5921, ImpRate=75.6%), mahalanobis_metric_epoch4 (Fine=0.9746, NMI=0.5944, ImpRate=71.4%), hybrid_stabilized_epoch1 (Fine=0.9638, NMI=0.5788, ImpRate=73.8%); (b) HIGH-ADVANTAGE (Citation/Outcome): cited_decisions_tfidf (ImpRate=97.1%, HierAdv=+0.1415), cited_outcome_hybrid_0.5 (ImpRate=86.8%, HierAdv=+0.2918, BEST PRODUCTION), cited_outcome_hybrid_0.7 (ImpRate=90.3%, HierAdv=+0.3703, BEST FRACTAL); (c) CITATION ROLE VIEWS: following_alpha0.3 (ImpRate=82.2%, Fine=0.9501), criticizing_alpha0.3 (Fine=0.9619, HierAdv=+0.0815), citing_alpha0.3 (ImpRate=66.9%). center_projected_hierarchical REPRODUCED as DEFAULT (nesting=1.0, purity=0.9571/0.9718, 7-res ladder, 108 clusters). Product integration COMPLETE: 24 representations across 4 design patterns (DEFAULT, HIGH-PURITY, HIGH-ADVANTAGE, CITATION ROLE) operational in product lane. NEXT: Scale fractal map to full corpus (192k) once corpus lane delivers.

evaluation.question: Define and execute v3: Validate legal-distance unsupervised signal ablation results (on center_projected baseline) and frontier_metric_learning_jurivoc supervised metric learning results on expanded slice (1,200 decisions) using adversarial benchmarks (language dominance, jurist pairwise, Jurivoc hierarchy alignment, scale stability, boilerplate resistance). center_projected is the default reference representation to beat. Freeze evaluation harness with global seed.

product.question: Vertical slice COMPLETE with center_projected_64dim_hierarchical as DEFAULT (97/97 tests, 14 representations). Continuous improvement phase: harden TF base map for production, optimize map rendering performance at scale, implement map mode comparison UI, add jurist feedback capture endpoints, prepare for full corpus (~192k) map persistence. User corpus import and map export are operational.
